detail.longDescription: The Pitch Deck Analyzer gives you investor-grade feedback in minutes — trained on 25,000+ real decks and the investor decisions that followed. Upload yours and get slide-by-slide fundability feedback — stage-calibrated, checking narrative cohesion and cross-checking your claims for contradictions investors will catch. Know exactly where you lose conviction before you ever hit send. Built by 1752vc, a VC firm evaluating 4,000+ startups a year.
